newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Sberbank holds 36 pct of govt paper mkt.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Sberbank holds 36 pct of govt paper mkt.

text.p: Russia's biggest bank, Sberegatelny Bank RF (Sberbank), holds 36 percent of Russian Treasury bills and government bonds, the bank said on Monday.
"The bank is the biggest operator on the government securities market," Sberbank said in a statment.
"Sberbank RF's total investment volume in GKO (discount Treasury bills) and OFZ (interest-bearing goverment bonds) by the start of 1997 tripled and came to 79.3 trillion roubles," it said.
In February Sberbank chairman Andrei Kazmin said Sberbank held 44 percent of total GKO and OFZ issues.
Foreigners hold about 20 percent of the market, according to Central Bank estimates.
On April 25 the total nominal market volume was 285.65 trillion roubles.
